system_a.summary: Across 100 reviews, guests consistently describe a clean, quiet, private basement apartment with a separate entrance, good value, and easy check-in. Hosts Allison and Peter are praised as responsive and welcoming, and the porch or deck views, mountain setting, and proximity to Asheville and the Biltmore come up often. Recent reviews (2024–2026) are mostly positive, citing cleanliness, peacefulness, clear instructions, and affordability. Limitations are mostly older or isolated: guests noted a steep driveway, a walk uphill from parking that may be hard for older travelers, and a narrow path to the door. Several 2015 reviews raised privacy and safety worries over no curtains and an unlockable door, though a 2019 review mentioned coded entry. Isolated complaints include an uncomfortable bed and spiders (2019), a refused partial refund, and no temperature control (2022). Reviewers describe it as simple and no-frills, best for sleeping and short stays.

system_b.summary: Reviews describe a basic basement apartment that guests across 2014–2026 often called clean, quiet, and good value, with hosts frequently described as responsive. Check-in was usually called easy, though the many short comments may not be independent. Access can be difficult: a steep, winding drive and driveway were reported, a 2024 guest said the uphill walk may challenge older visitors, and a 2022 guest noted a narrow passage by the stairs. Historical concerns from 2015 include a private entrance that reportedly would not lock and missing window coverings, even as others praised the privacy; current status is unclear. Bed comfort was mostly praised, but 2018–2019 guests reported a sinking or uncomfortable bed, and a 2022 guest couldn't control the temperature. One 2019 report mentioned spiders, and another described a refused partial refund. The location is convenient by car, about 10–20 minutes from downtown Asheville.

selected_claims.claim: Reviewers across many years describe the unit as clean, with only one report of spiders in the bathroom (2019). Recent reviews (2024-2026) continue to call it clean or spotless.

selected_claims.uncertainty: Extracted evidence, not verified. Spider mention is a single report.

selected_claims.claim: The private entrance was left unlocked and could not be locked. Several early guests said they lacked full security, and one said it bothered a spouse. The evidence does not show whether this is still the case.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reported in 2015 only. Later reviews mention a coded entry (2019), so current lock status is unclear.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No evidence either way that the lock issue was resolved. Coded entry in R0042 may or may not be related.

selected_claims.claim: Early guests reported no curtains or blinds, raising privacy concerns. Other guests praised the private entrance and privacy generally.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Window-covering complaints are from 2015; privacy praise spans 2016-2023.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Not known whether window coverings were added later.

selected_claims.claim: Access involves a steep, winding mountain drive and steep driveway. Another 2024 guest wished they could drop luggage at the driveway.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports from 2020-2024, with the accessibility concern in 2024.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Few reviewers mention this, but it matters for mobility-limited guests.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is described as easy or seamless by a large majority across the years, including 2025-2026. Minor early complaints concerned confusing house numbers and parking on muddy grass.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports from 2015-2026; the numbering and mud complaints are from 2015.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Many short, similar comments; they are not necessarily independent.

selected_claims.claim: Most guests found the bed and space comfortable and spacious. A minority reported a bed that sinks and caused backaches (2019) or was not very comfortable (2018). One reviewer could not control the room temperature and found the air conditioning cold (2022). Space heaters were provided for cool nights.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed complaints are from 2018-2019; praise continues through 2026. No recent bed complaints in the ledger.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Cannot say whether the mattress was replaced.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is a basic, no-frills basement apartment with essentials, a mini fridge, toiletries, coffee and a porch or deck. One guest said it suits sleeping more than extended time on site, and one 2019 guest was given only two towels for three people.

selected_claims.uncertainty: The towel issue is a single report, and the reviewer said it was not a problem.

selected_claims.claim: The location is quiet and peaceful, about 10-20 minutes from downtown Asheville and near the Biltmore. It is convenient by car, but one reviewer said it is best with your own transportation.
